meta.focus: APP COMPLETENESS: Every view must be 100% functional, error-free, and polished.

tasks.title: [AUDIT] Home/Landing Page Completeness
tasks.description: Verify Home page functionality: CTA buttons, auth state transitions, and responsive layout. Ensure zero console errors.

tasks.title: [AUDIT] Dashboard Completeness
tasks.description: Verify User Dashboard: Quick match buttons, stat overview widgets, and recent activity feed. Check data fetching error handling.

tasks.title: [CODE] Roster/Squad Data Consistency Fix
tasks.description: Align Fighter/Squad domain models with DB schema. Fix missing XP fields in Fighter model and ensure Squad members are correctly hydrated in usecase layer.

tasks.title: [AUDIT] Roster View & Fighter Management
tasks.description: Ensure fighter list, detailed stats view, and equipment integration are fully operational. Fix any 'stub' or missing data displays.

tasks.title: [AUDIT] Inventory & Equipment Forge
tasks.description: Validate weapon inventory, filtering, and enhancement UI (Forge). Ensure rarity colors and tooltips match Ethereal Iron theme.

tasks.title: [AUDIT] Shop System & Transactions
tasks.description: Verify gold package displays, bundle descriptions, and purchase flows. Ensure balance updates correctly after purchase.

tasks.title: [AUDIT] Matches & Match Viewer
tasks.description: Test match browsing, joining, and the real-time observer/viewer. Ensure logic for replay playback is smooth and visual effects are polished.

tasks.title: [AUDIT] Leagues & Highscores
tasks.description: Confirm league subscription modal works, highscore aggregation is accurate, and previous winners are displayed.

tasks.title: [AUDIT] Squad Management UI
tasks.description: Verify squad creation, slot assignment (3-fighter limit), and active squad persistence.

tasks.title: [AUDIT] Attunement Progression View
tasks.description: Check attunement leveling, XP history display, and elemental bonus calculations.

tasks.title: [AUDIT] Leaderboard Analytics
tasks.description: Ensue rankings by category (kills, wins, power) are correctly fetched and paginated.

tasks.title: [FEAT] Guild System
tasks.description: Add guild system: players can form/join guilds, chat, compete.

tasks.title: [INFRA] Community Monitoring Pipeline
tasks.description: Design and implement community monitoring for Discord, Reddit, and Store reviews.
